_about: G. K. Chesterton (1874-1936): the five books first published 1926-1928 that pipeline/fetch_sources.py lists as DEFERRED because they are on neither CCEL nor Gutenberg. The other 61 Chesterton works are already held through fetch_sources.py (CHESTERTON_CCEL and the Gutenberg Chesterton entries) and are cross-referenced, not refetched. These are raw Internet Archive OCR (the Edwards precedent), unconverted. Pre-1929 only, as the relay asked: the 1929 and 1930 books are US public domain too and are listed as pending. Each scan is a pre-1930 printing, so US public domain; Chesterton died in 1936, so life+70 and life+80 countries differ.

chesterton-incredulity-of-father-brown: The Incredulity of Father Brown (1926; New York: Dodd, Mead, 1926)
chesterton-outline-of-sanity: The Outline of Sanity (1926; New York: Dodd, Mead, 1927)
chesterton-return-of-don-quixote: The Return of Don Quixote (1927; New York: Dodd, Mead, 1927)
chesterton-robert-louis-stevenson: Robert Louis Stevenson (1927; London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1927)
chesterton-generally-speaking: Generally Speaking: A Book of Essays (1928; New York: Dodd, Mead, 1929)

_excluded.chesterton-held: HELD elsewhere: the 61 works in pipeline/fetch_sources.py (CHESTERTON_CCEL and the Gutenberg Chesterton entries); not refetched
_excluded.chesterton-1929-1930: PENDING, outside the relay's pre-1929 limit though US public domain since 2025-2026: The Thing (1929), The Poet and the Lunatics (1929), Four Faultless Felons (1930), The Resurrection of Rome (1930), Come to Think of It (1930)
_excluded.chesterton-not-pd: 1931 and later (Autobiography, The Well and the Shallows, Chaucer, The Scandal of Father Brown, St. Thomas Aquinas and the rest): not yet US public domain
_excluded.chesterton-other-scans: other scans of the same books (DLI copies 404 on the text file; later reprints of 1937 and 1953; the 1906 Robert Louis Stevenson booklet with W. Robertson Nicoll is a different work)
